title: Validity of the Intermediate 8-Round Gimli-Hash Differential Pattern
summary: The MILP search did not refute the proposed pattern, but no confirming assignment was found, so its validity remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Does there exist a conforming pair for the proposed intermediate $8$-round Gimli-Hash differential pattern?

scope.domain: Differential cryptanalysis and automated verification of the reduced Gimli hash construction.
parameters: 8 rounds, the round count of the intermediate Gimli-Hash differential pattern
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish whether a conforming pair exists for the proposed intermediate 8-round Gimli-Hash differential pattern.

citations.label: Automatic Verification of Differential Characteristics: Application to Reduced Gimli

progress.summary: The authors apply a MILP model after noting that the pattern's validity may be doubted. Because the solver neither found a solution in practical time nor reported infeasibility, they state only that they believe the pattern is reasonable.
citation_labels: Fukang Liu et al., Automatic Verification of Differential Characteristics: Application to Reduced Gimli
